# Test data

This directory is reserved for synthetic or sanitized Braiins API fixtures
created during Milestone 01.

Before committing a fixture, remove tokens, account identifiers, payout and
wallet addresses, transaction identifiers, personally identifying data, and
any operator-sensitive values. Document what was changed. Prefer synthetic
fixtures when they preserve the behavior being tested.

`testdata/braiins/` contains synthetic fixtures shaped from official Braiins
documentation examples. They are not raw account responses.
